title: Scalar extension preserves an augmented localization model
statement: For commutative rings A,B with ordinary derived categories on their one-object bottom sites, a ring homomorphism φ:A→B, finitely generated ideals I,J with φ(I)B=J, and a K-flat augmented complex (P,εP) satisfying RingComplexHasCechModel(A,I,P,εP), there exists an augmentation εE:Eφ(P)→B[0] satisfying RingComplexHasCechModel(B,J,Eφ(P),εE), normalized by εE(1 tensor x)=φ(εP(x)) on degree-zero sections. Eφ is the actual scalar-extension functor of [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-semilinear-extension], the model predicate is [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data], and K-flatness is [def-pc-kflat-complex].

source.place: Tags 0ALZ and 099D(c); the original node proof steps 1 and 2

proof.text: Choose a finite generating list f of I. Extract its ordered complex C and augmented derived isomorphism C≅P from the model predicate. Its coordinates imply boundedness and flatness: terms above the list length are empty products, and all nonzero terms are finite products of flat localizations. Thus C is K-flat.

Represent the augmented derived isomorphism by a right roof. Refine the roof until the augmentation equation is an actual cochain homotopy, then choose a K-flat resolution of the refined source. Both composite legs are quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes; actual scalar extension preserves them. Apply its additive action to the homotopy and invert the two legs, retaining the augmented equation.

The image list φ∘f generates J. The Godement model supplies an explicit ordered complex D for that image list and an augmented derived isomorphism from D to the fixed Godement model. The explicit ordered scalar isomorphism identifies Eφ(C) with D and respects the canonical scalar augmentation. Compose this comparison with the preceding roof to obtain an augmented derived isomorphism from the Godement model to Eφ(P).

For an arbitrary generating list of J, take its model and augmented derived isomorphism to the same Godement complex. Compose with the comparison to Eφ(P). This supplies every coordinate and augmentation required by RingComplexHasCechModel. The pure-tensor normalization is the proved canonical augmentation formula.

theorem ringComplex_cech_scalar_model
    (A B : CommRingCat.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (RingSiteModules A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (RingSiteModules B)] (φ : A →+* B)
    (I : {I : Ideal A // I.FG}) (J : {J : Ideal B // J.FG})
    (h : I.val.map φ = J.val)
    (P : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules A) ℤ)
    (εP : P ⟶ ringComplexSingle A)
    (hCA : RingComplexHasCechModel A I.val P εP) (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat) :
    ∃ εE : ringComplexExtensionComplex φ P ⟶ ringComplexSingle B,
      RingComplexHasCechModel B J.val (ringComplexExtensionComplex φ P) εE ∧
      ∀ x : (P.X 0).val.obj (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩),
        ringComplexAugmentationValue εE
          ((toSheafify ⊥ (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf
            (ringSiteMap φ) (P.X 0)).presheaf).app (op ⟨PUnit.unit⟩)
              ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[A, φ] x)) = φ (ringComplexAugmentationValue εP x)
